entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
aliases: the plane of light and shadow
entities.description: A twinned plane with a daytime aspect, Lorwyn, and a nighttime aspect, Shadowmoor, whose aspects now bleed into one another.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The daytime aspect of the plane, a world of idyllic meadows and verdant forests where the sun never fully sets.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The nighttime aspect of the plane, a land of dark forests, brambles and eternal night under a cycling moon.

entities.name: Primal Beyond
entities.description: The areas beyond the known and tamed expanse of Lorwyn.

entities.name: Eclipsed realms
entities.description: Pockets that emerge where the boundaries of Lorwyn and Shadowmoor grind together, a third state of neither light nor shadow that slowly transforms those who stay in them.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The magical convergence orchestrated by Oona that shifted the whole plane between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor about every three hundred years.

entities.name: Pendulum Year
entities.description: The period after Oona's reign ended when the plane began to fuse together.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: An event over forty years ago that healed the entire Multiverse of damage from accumulated time rifts and disrupted the Great Aurora cycle.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault that destroyed the plane's fragile power balance and forced its species to cooperate.

entities.name: Oona
aliases: queen and mother of all faeries
entities.description: The ancient faerie queen who once ruled Lorwyn-Shadowmoor in secret; she was defeated and her body destroyed, but her consciousness remains hidden and recovering.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: A Mornsong elf created by Oona as a duplicate, who gained sentience, helped defeat Oona and became the new queen of the fae.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: An elf who helped defeat Oona, bound to Maralen by a death pact; he must kill her if Oona returns and can never die until then.

entities.name: Brigid
entities.description: A kithkin who was part of the coalition that defeated Oona.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A merrow who was part of the coalition that defeated Oona.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin who was part of the coalition that defeated Oona.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: A treefolk sapling who was part of the coalition that defeated Oona.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The living embodiment of Lorwyn and symbol of the sun, a massive being that wanders the plane and is worshiped by many.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The living embodiment of Shadowmoor and symbol of the moon, a massive being that wanders the plane and is worshiped by many.

entities.name: Worshipers of Eirdu
entities.description: Followers who wear sunburst armor and seek to convert the entire plane into Lorwyn.

entities.name: Worshipers of Isilu
entities.description: Followers who wear moon-motif armor, hold vigils over their dead and seek to convert the entire plane into Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Reliquaries
entities.description: Rare sacred items made from pieces of Eirdu or Isilu that let a bearer keep their form and memories across aspects.

entities.name: Crescent of Morningtide
entities.description: An ancient relic, empowered by a great elemental, that could bridge the gap between aspects without changing the bearer.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: Small humanoids bound together by the thoughtweft; communal farmers in Lorwyn and insular, paranoid villagers in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: The empathetic web connecting the minds of all kithkin.

entities.name: Hound of Bristlebane
entities.description: A young Shadowmoor kithkin woman who rode a springjack and drove a spear through a Dominus during the invasion.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Goblin creatures who pursue novel sensations; playful in Lorwyn and ravenous and volatile in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Merrow
entities.description: Merfolk who work as merchants and intermediaries and use glamers; aristocratic in Lorwyn and con artists in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: Idealistic lovers of beauty; cruel eugenicists in Lorwyn and protectors of beauty in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: The High Perfect of the Lorwyn elves, who seeks to rally people under elvish authority to end the existence of Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Flamekin
entities.description: Passionate elementals of flame and living stone; rimekin emerged from flamekin after the invasion and cinders are their Shadowmoor form.

entities.name: Faeries
entities.description: Fickle, mischievous pranksters born from Oona who use illusion magic and sustain themselves with dreamstuff.

entities.name: Queen Oura
entities.description: A faerie who proclaimed herself queen by mimicking Oona and is worshiped by many Lorwyn faeries.

entities.name: Giants
entities.description: Massive, ancient humanoids who spend much of their time asleep.

entities.name: Treefolk
entities.description: Sentient trees with humanoid features, the oldest creatures native to the plane.

entities.name: Greater elementals
entities.description: Massive embodiments of ideas and concepts, untamable and beyond good and evil.

entities.name: Changelings
entities.description: Shapeshifters born in the crystalline cavern Velis Vel; in Shadowmoor they become cruel mimics.

entities.name: Firdoch
entities.description: Stone creatures that wander the lands, serving the elemental guardians and managing the boundaries between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: The place where the untainted elves and allied species made a stand against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: A narrow mountain valley shielded by glamers where faeries have historically lived and where Maralen now rules.

entities.name: Dawn's Light Palace
entities.description: The palace where Perfects cultivate moonglow.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: The seat to which elvish fiefdoms are connected as a means of survival.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who attacked the plane, compleated elves and infected kithkin and faeries.

events.summary: Oona is defeated and destroyed, ending her control over the cycle of day and night, but her meddling leaves the plane's aspects bleeding into one another.
events.quote: the queen and mother of all faeries, Oona, had been defeated and destroyed, and her control over the cycle of day and night had ended.

events.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the Great Aurora cycle, making Oona fear she might be affected.
events.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted over forty years ago by the Great Mending

events.summary: Oona creates a duplicate Maralen and gives it a piece of her soul to preserve her memories.
events.quote: she created a duplicate Maralen, a Mornsong elf, and instilled this duplicate with a piece of her soul

events.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
events.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

events.summary: Maralen becomes queen of the fae and binds herself to Rhys with a death pact.
events.quote: Maralen took on the mantle of queen of the fae and bound herself to Rhys with a death pact.

events.summary: Pockets of Lorwyn sprout across Shadowmoor, splitting villages and throwing the plane into turmoil.
events.quote: Across Shadowmoor, pockets of Lorwyn sprouted up in the darkness.

events.summary: Eirdu and Isilu awaken from the firmament as the aspects merge.
events.quote: two great beings awoke from the firmament above the plane: Eirdu, the incarnation of the sun, and Isilu, the incarnation of the moon.

events.summary: Eclipsed realms begin to appear, as tales emerge of places caught between light and darkness.
events.quote: These areas came to be known as eclipsed realms.

events.summary: The Phyrexian invasion destroys the plane's power balance and nearly decimates the Lorwyn elves, whose networks of power are turned to Phyrexian use.
events.quote: The Phyrexian invasion destroyed the fragile power balance of the plane

events.summary: Untainted Lorwyn elves ally with the other species and make a stand at Lys Alana.
events.quote: they were finally able to gain ground and make a stand at Lys Alana.

events.summary: Shadowmoor boggarts form the vanguard against the invaders, riding cavalry into enemy lines at great cost.
events.quote: The boggarts formed the vanguard, riding their cavalry into the enemy lines and gutting them from within.

events.summary: Shadowmoor kithkin lead the last charge that destroys the Phyrexian invaders, then shut themselves in their homes.
events.quote: it was the isolationist Shadowmoor kithkin that led the last charge to destroy the invaders.

events.summary: The Hound of Bristlebane skewers a Dominus with a spear along a branch of the Invasion Tree.
events.quote: singlehandedly drove a spear through the body of a Dominus, skewering it from neck to knee

events.summary: Lorwyn merrow flee into the deepest parts of the Wanderwine when the Phyrexians attack the water.
events.quote: Many were forced to flee into the deepest parts of the Wanderwine.

events.summary: Shadowmoor merrow escape to the Dark Meanders to wait out the invasion and adapt to their new environment.
events.quote: they escaped to the Dark Meanders, tunnels deep under the plane, hoping to wait out the invasion beneath the water.

events.summary: Many flamekin disappear underground and hibernate; around half later return as rimekin.
events.quote: with around half of them having returned as rimekin, their hibernation causing a change in forms.

events.summary: Elvish authority in Lorwyn collapses as the invasion destroys the infrastructure of the power imbalance, letting other species reclaim sovereignty.
events.quote: This vacuum allowed the other species on the plane to gain ground, clawing back ancestral lands and reclaiming sovereignty.

relations.note: Maralen was created as a duplicate avatar of Oona.
relations.quote: Maralen—an avatar of Oona that gained self-awareness—was created

relations.note: Maralen defied Oona and ultimately killed her.
relations.quote: Maralen defied and ultimately killed Oona to become the new queen of the fae.

relations.note: Maralen is the new queen of the fae ruling from Glen Elendra.
relations.quote: Maralen is the new great faerie who rules from Glen Elendra and stewards the plane.

relations.note: Bound by a death pact; Rhys must kill her if Oona returns.
relations.quote: If there is ever a sign that Oona might return, Rhys is to kill Maralen.

relations.note: All faeries came from Oona and gathered secrets and dreamstuff to empower her.
relations.quote: Faeries would empower and sustain her by gathering secrets and dreamstuff

relations.note: Eirdu is the living embodiment of Lorwyn.
relations.quote: Eirdu is the living embodiment of Lorwyn and a symbol of the sun.

relations.note: Isilu is the living embodiment of Shadowmoor.
relations.quote: Isilu is the living embodiment of Shadowmoor and a symbol of the moon.

relations.note: They worship Eirdu and rally behind its symbols.
relations.quote: The worshipers of Eirdu lay claim to all of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and seek to convert the entire plane into Lorwyn.

relations.note: They worship Isilu and rally behind its symbols.
relations.quote: The worshipers of Isilu lay claim to all Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and seek to convert the entire plane into Shadowmoor.

relations.note: Each side seeks to convert the whole plane to its own aspect.
relations.quote: seek to convert the entire plane into Shadowmoor

relations.note: A Reliquary of Dawn is fashioned from a piece of Eirdu.
relations.quote: you must carry a Reliquary of Dawn fashioned from a piece of Eirdu

relations.note: Kithkin minds are bound together by the thoughtweft.
relations.quote: They are mentally bound together by the magical thoughtweft.
The Hound of Bristlebane, a young kithkin woman who rode a springjack mount into battle

relations.note: High Perfect Morcant is the head of the Lorwyn elves' fiefdoms, who pay tribute to him.
relations.quote: each with their own leader at the head who is expected to pay tribute to High Perfect Morcant.
elves frequently and cruelly slaughtered boggarts for sport.

relations.note: Phyrexians infected kithkin and exploited the thoughtweft.
relations.quote: infecting kithkin and using the thoughtweft to poison their comrades' minds

relations.note: Firdoch serve the elemental guardians of the plane.
relations.quote: They serve the elemental guardians of the plane in mysterious ways

relations.note: They form along the borders between aspects.
relations.quote: They exist along the borders between aspects
